note: The living record of the AI buildout. 'date' drives placement; 'tier' is major (always shown) or minor (unlockable). Append new events here. Sourced from filings, company announcements, and press.

events.title: US restricts AI chips to China
events.description: BIS blocks NVIDIA's A100 and H100 to China without a license.
events.whyItMatters: Export controls become a permanent force shaping where demand can legally flow.

events.title: ChatGPT launches
events.description: OpenAI's chatbot reaches ~100M users in two months.
events.whyItMatters: The consumer moment that turned AI into a demand shock the whole chain now serves.

events.title: Microsoft's ~$10B OpenAI bet
events.description: Microsoft deepens its OpenAI stake and makes Azure its cloud.
events.whyItMatters: The first mega-deal wiring a lab to a hyperscaler; a template everyone copied.

events.title: Anthropic launches Claude
events.description: A second serious frontier lab enters the race.

events.title: GPT-4 released
events.description: A capability jump that accelerates enterprise adoption.
events.whyItMatters: Raised the compute bar for training and inference industry-wide.

events.title: NVIDIA's demand-signal quarter
events.description: NVIDIA guides revenue far above expectations; shares jump ~24%.
events.whyItMatters: The first hard proof in the financials that AI demand was real.

events.title: NVIDIA nears $1T value
events.description: Briefly joins the trillion-dollar club on AI optimism.
events.whyItMatters: Markets start pricing the buildout as a durable multi-year cycle.

events.title: xAI founded
events.description: Elon Musk launches a new lab that becomes a major GPU buyer.

events.title: Meta releases Llama 2
events.description: Open weights let anyone build on a strong base, expanding demand.

events.title: Amazon backs Anthropic
events.description: Amazon commits up to $4B to Anthropic, making AWS a core partner.
events.whyItMatters: A second lab-hyperscaler axis forms, splitting the field.

events.title: China chip controls tightened
events.description: BIS closes the H800/A800 loophole NVIDIA used to keep selling into China.

events.title: Broadcom closes VMware
events.description: Broadcom completes its ~$69B VMware acquisition.
events.whyItMatters: Reshapes Broadcom into a software-plus-AI-silicon giant.

events.title: Google launches Gemini
events.description: Google's flagship family arrives, backed by its own TPUs.

events.title: AMD launches MI300X
events.description: AMD's first credible data-center GPU challenger ships.

events.title: Anthropic releases Claude 3
events.description: A capability leap that intensifies frontier competition.

events.title: NVIDIA unveils Blackwell
events.description: Next-gen GPU architecture announced at GTC.
events.whyItMatters: Sets the hardware roadmap the whole chain races to build.

events.title: Microsoft invests $1.5B in G42
events.description: An early bet linking a US hyperscaler to a Gulf AI champion.

events.title: Meta releases Llama 3
events.description: Meta pushes open weights further, backed by huge capex.

events.title: NVIDIA hits $3T, briefly the world's most valuable
events.description: NVIDIA overtakes Microsoft and Apple to top global market cap.
events.whyItMatters: The clearest sign yet that the market had reorganized itself around AI hardware.

events.title: xAI's Colossus comes online
events.description: A ~100,000-GPU cluster stood up in Memphis in months.
events.whyItMatters: Proof a new entrant can assemble world-class compute at speed.

events.title: OpenAI releases o1
events.description: A reasoning model that spends far more compute at inference.
events.whyItMatters: Shifts demand toward inference; a structural change.

events.title: OpenAI raises $6.6B at $157B
events.description: A giant round cements OpenAI as the most valuable AI startup.

events.title: Amazon-Anthropic reaches $8B
events.description: Amazon doubles its Anthropic commitment to $8B total.

events.title: xAI raises $6B
events.description: A mega-round funds xAI's rapid compute expansion.

events.title: Stargate announced
events.description: $500B over four years from OpenAI, SoftBank, Oracle, and MGX.
events.whyItMatters: The largest single AI-infrastructure commitment yet; announced at the White House.

events.title: DeepSeek shock
events.description: A low-cost Chinese model triggers NVIDIA's ~$600B single-day drop, the largest in market history.
events.whyItMatters: The first serious 'what if AI needs less compute?' scare.

events.title: CoreWeave IPO
events.description: The first big neocloud goes public on Nasdaq; NVIDIA holds ~7%.
events.whyItMatters: Public markets validate the neocloud model and its ties to NVIDIA.

events.title: NVIDIA's H20 blocked from China
events.description: A license requirement wipes out an estimated $4.5B in China revenue.

events.title: HUMAIN launches — sovereign AI
events.description: Saudi Arabia's PIF unveils HUMAIN with NVIDIA; the US rescinds the AI Diffusion Rule the same day.
events.whyItMatters: Nation-states enter as buyers, treating compute like a strategic asset.

events.title: CoreWeave to buy Core Scientific
events.description: A ~$9B all-stock deal adding ~1.3 GW of power capacity.

events.title: NVIDIA hits $4T
events.description: First company ever to reach a $4 trillion valuation.
events.whyItMatters: Markets treat NVIDIA as the keystone of the AI economy.

events.title: Meta commits to gigawatt superclusters
events.description: Meta unveils multi-gigawatt projects (Prometheus, Hyperion).

events.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5
events.description: OpenAI's next flagship keeps compute demand climbing.

events.title: SoftBank puts $2B in Intel
events.description: A ~2% stake, days before the US government's larger move.

events.title: US takes ~10% of Intel
events.description: Washington acquires a ~$8.9B stake in the chipmaker.
events.whyItMatters: Government treats domestic chip capacity as national infrastructure.

events.title: NVIDIA invests $5B in Intel
events.description: A stake plus a chip partnership with its onetime rival, at $23.28/share.
events.whyItMatters: Even rivals now lean on NVIDIA's capital and roadmap.

events.title: NVIDIA: up to $100B into OpenAI
events.description: A 10 GW letter of intent; NVIDIA invests in its biggest customer.
events.whyItMatters: The clearest circular-financing signal yet.

events.title: AMD-OpenAI, 6 GW
events.description: OpenAI agrees to deploy 6 GW of AMD GPUs over time.
events.whyItMatters: OpenAI diversifies beyond NVIDIA; AMD lands a huge anchor.

events.title: Stargate adds five US sites
events.description: Expansion brings planned US capacity to nearly 7 GW.

events.title: US clears advanced chips for the Gulf
events.description: Commerce approves up to ~70,000 Blackwell GPUs for HUMAIN and G42.
events.whyItMatters: Chip diplomacy becomes explicit foreign policy.

events.title: SoftBank completes $41B into OpenAI
events.description: One of the largest private rounds ever, for ~11% of OpenAI.

events.title: NVIDIA completes $5B Intel buy
events.description: The September agreement closes after clearance.

events.title: Stargate's Abilene campus goes live
events.description: The flagship Texas site reaches 1.2 GW of GB200 GPUs.

events.title: OpenAI raises $122B
events.description: One of the largest funding rounds in history, plus a separate ~$110B strategic round with Amazon and NVIDIA.
events.whyItMatters: The capital feeding the buildout now dwarfs anything venture ever did.

events.title: Broadcom, Apollo & Blackstone: $35B for Anthropic
events.description: An SPV finances Broadcom custom chips and leases them to Anthropic — debt, not equity.
events.whyItMatters: The buildout starts being financed like industrial infrastructure.

events.title: TSMC lifts 2026 capex to ~$64B
events.description: The foundry's record capital budget signals confidence the demand is durable.

events.title: Anthropic builds an in-house chip team
events.description: Anthropic hires chip engineers to co-design its own inference silicon.
events.whyItMatters: Even the labs move to design their own chips, chasing independence from NVIDIA.

events.title: NVIDIA backs $105B for OpenAI's Ohio data center
events.description: An SEC filing reveals NVIDIA financing up to $105B for a 4.25 GW (eventually up to 8 GW) OpenAI campus.
events.whyItMatters: The circular-financing loop at its most extreme — NVIDIA underwriting demand for its own chips.

events.title: NVIDIA lines up $500B financing platform
events.description: NVIDIA teams with BlackRock, Goldman Sachs and others to deploy $500B+ into data centers.

events.title: Circular-financing scrutiny intensifies
events.description: Analysts warn mutual investments may inflate 'artificial demand'; one OpenAI-NVIDIA figure comes in $145B lower than billed.
events.whyItMatters: The bear case matures from a one-day scare into a structural question.
